alignment_operator: Linearly interpolate profile longitude/latitude to overlapping DAC timestamps, then compute WGS84 position separation. This audits internal source alignment; it cannot independently establish true georeferencing.
source_metadata_conflict: Both DAC_U long_name attributes call the component northward, while DAC_U standard_name identifies eastward. Preserve both; this audit plots direction-independent vector magnitudes. Direction validation remains open.
